comparisons.calibration: same-chain seed-aa versus seed; report candidate contrasts against seed-aa as well
comparisons.required: Retain every member, stratum, failure, abstention and adverse change; descriptive paired uncertainty only, no small-panel efficacy claim.

efficiency: Actual mean/all and non-first sample wall time, per-node prefill/decode/transport, first4/rest diagnostic, throughput separately. Same observed admission order across members; do not relabel non-first warm.
frontier: Same-cohort nondominated official quality, intent, reliability and measured latency; separate from algorithm retention.
implementation_amendment: Apply unchanged official projection, paired estimators, strata, measured-cost frontier and original TRAIN reward reference to the complete configuration-bound cohort; derive all counts/member IDs from its pinned config.
launch_worker_policy: Prospectively bind unchanged official projection, estimators and source readers before any quality read. The original-a runtime is already frozen and running; other cohorts remain DRAFT. Never edit runtime or recipe to select an outcome.
output_boundary: Root complete configured cohort interpretation only; no partial population learner export, pooled frontier or cross-cohort return normalization.
quality: Official pooled SLU-F1; separate intent accuracy, reliable completion, failure and abstention rates.
repairs_and_damage: Between complete systems, a whole answer is exact when intent is correct and official exact-entity FP=FN=0; empty correct entities count as correct. This association does not establish a within-trajectory or node causal effect. Separate source-verified role diagnostics are required to explain a mechanism.

resampling.unit: paired utterance; keep all recording variants together

reward: Frozen original TRAIN reference utility after exact complete-family READ. Future learner views contain templates, abstract structural features, measured costs and numeric terminal counts only; no concrete utterance/entity/knowledge/source roster.
status: PINNED BEFORE ANY COHORT QUALITY READ; runtime/READ authority remain separate

source_compatibility_review.review: Commit a3af791f6 only accepts the new process-aware optimizer packet v2 in two update-record dispatch checks. Complete-family scope, official projection and estimators are unchanged.

reporting_priority: official business quality and reliable completion
source-bound support, review, repair and damage diagnostics
process_metrics: After exact root READ, use verified initial draft/first review joins; distinguish raw-model revision from deterministic postprocessing, false alarms from detection, unknown support from absent support. No causal credit or runtime gold.
